item.title: American Airlines nationwide ground stop lifted after IT outage disrupts flights
item.description: According to the Air Traffic Control System Command Center, all airports and facilities were being impacted by the IT outage.

item.title: eBay settles with couple "terrorized" in bizarre stalking scandal
item.description: eBay has agreed to pay a large settlement after a Massachusetts couple was the victim of a bizarre harassment campaign​.

item.title: U.S. says it thwarted Iranian missile attack on troops in Middle East
item.description: Iran launched multiple ballistic missiles at U.S. forces in the Middle East in what U.S. Central Command described as an "attempted surprise attack" on Tuesday.

item.title: Fauci diaries, released by Sen. Paul, touch on COVID origins, Trump
item.description: Republican Sen. Rand Paul released more than a thousand pages of journal entries from Dr. Anthony Fauci, teeing up what is likely to be a contentious hearing on Wednesday.

item.title: Trump policy clears way for civil commitment of homeless in some states
item.description: In the year since President Trump signed an executive order aimed at moving homeless people off the streets, states have expanded involuntary treatment for the homeless.

item.title: U.S. and Saudi Arabia strike "Iran-aligned terrorists" in Iraq
item.description: The U.S. and Saudi militaries announced airstrikes late Tuesday on Iranian-backed groups in Iraq, after Iran and its proxies allegedly targeted American forces.

item.title: Trump meets with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu amid wars in Iran, Ukraine
item.description: President Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu Tuesday.

item.title: Former Cowboys star Tony Romo arrested on suspicion of driving while intoxicated in Wisconsin, sheriff says
item.description: Romo has a court date scheduled for Sept. 21 at 8:30 a.m.

item.title: Japan quake kills at least 13; more trapped in collapsed mall, factory
item.description: A major earthquake in Japan's southwest killed at least 13 people and left several injured or missing after a shopping center and a paper mill were heavily damaged.

item.title: Examining the legal process behind Fauci diaries release
item.description: Republican Sen. Rand Paul of Kentucky has released some of Dr. Anthony Fauci's pandemic-era diary entries ahead of the former National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases director's Senate hearing on Wednesday. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson breaks down the subpoena power behind the release.

item.title: Former national security official on the importance of Trump's meetings with Netanyahu, Zelenskyy
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu both met with President Trump separately at the White House on Tuesday. Former Clinton and Obama National Security Council member Charles Kupchan joins with analysis.

item.title: Swaths of damage as tornado tears through Wisconsin
item.description: Trees and power lines collapsed around cars as a tornado with winds of 140 miles per hour tore through central Wisconsin on Monday. The National Weather Service found a 12-mile-long swath of damage. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for a "Marshall Plan for America" to fight wealth inequality
item.description: Democratic Rep. Ro Khanna of California is beginning what he's calling the "New Economic Patriotism" tour Tuesday in his birthplace of Pennsylvania. Khanna joins "The Takeout" to discuss this and more.

item.title: Trump calls Graham "beloved friend" and "American original" in eulogy
item.description: President Trump delivered the eulogy for friend and ally Sen. Lindsey Graham, who died unexpectedly just a short time after visiting Ukraine earlier this month.

item.title: Sen. Lindsey Graham remembered by Trump, Thune and more as funeral held
item.description: Sen. Lindsey Graham's funeral took place Tuesday in Washington, D.C., with tributes from President Trump and others. CBS News' Taurean Small has more from Capitol Hill.

item.title: Senate confirms Jay Clayton as Trump's next intelligence chief
item.description: Clayton's confirmation as director of national intelligence could unlock gridlock over a key spy tool that lapsed last month.

item.title: Filmmaker shares rare footage of Lindsey Graham
item.description: Documentary filmmaker Alex Holder, who spent the last few years following Lindsey Graham, is sharing behind-the-scenes videos of his time recording the late South Carolina senator. Holder joins "The Takeout" to discuss what he took from the experience.

item.title: Florida executes 2 men in one day, including ex-cop who killed girl
item.description: Florida on Tuesday became the first state in nearly a decade to carry out two executions in a single day,​ putting to death an 80-year-old man who was the second-oldest inmate known to receive a lethal injection in modern U.S. history.

item.title: Trump meets with Netanyahu for first time since Iran war began
item.description: President Trump took separate meetings with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Tuesday. CBS News' Natalie Brand has the details.

item.title: The American South's evolving politics
item.description: A new YouTube series is pulling back the curtain on the political complexities of the American South. "Long Play: Winning the South" explores the importance of six states through the people who've helped shape them. Co-host and former New Orleans Mayor Mitch Landrieu joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: How Trump drafted renovation plans for Dulles, a "terrible airport"
item.description: President Trump asked for 3D models of the renovation proposals as he personally tweaked ideas to overhaul Dulles International Airport that are scheduled to be unveiled on Wednesday.

item.title: 7/28: CBS Evening News
item.description: Storms batter the Northeast, triggering travel delays; deadly earthquake devastates southern Japan.

item.title: Canadian tourism slumped in the U.S. last year amid heightened tensions
item.description: Millions of Canadians shunned travel to the U.S. in 2025, opting to vacation at home or travel to other countries.

item.title: 7/28: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: The funeral for Sen. Lindsey Graham is held in Washington, D.C.; Trump meets with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu.

item.title: DOJ tests limits of never-before-used court to deport suspected terrorist
item.description: The Alien Terrorist Removal Court was created by Congress in 1996 and signed into law by President Bill Clinton. Before now, it had never been used.

item.title: Biden tapes released after legal battle, with references to classified material
item.description: Audio recordings that former President Joe Biden fought for years to keep private have now been released.

item.title: 7/26: Sunday Morning
item.description: Hosted by Mo Rocca. Featured: Aging in rural America; compromises to food safety; supermodel and actress Lauren Hutton; singer Corinne Bailey Rae; artist Derrick Adams; worm grunting; and how plants are affected by touch.

item.title: 5 charts that illustrate America's deepening affordability crisis
item.description: Although inflation has eased, many Americans say they still feel squeezed financially. Here are five areas where households are feeling the pinch.

item.title: Inflation is creeping higher, putting pressure on American consumers
item.description: The Consumer Price Index likely inched higher in August, reflecting higher costs for food and other items, economists say.

item.title: Tracking cost of cars, trucks, groceries as Trump announces new tariffs
item.description: CBS News is tracking the rising cost of products most impacted by tariffs already imposed​ and new ones announced by President Trump, from grocery items to cars and trucks.
